messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT INC-5238 026-04-02T09:22:45Z 0% 5xx on inference-prod-east. Paging @maya. Severity: S3 (customer errors, partial degradation).
Maya Patel: On call ack. Jumping in. Any recent deploys to prod-east?
Oscar Ruiz: Small model packaging push at 09:19 (model-a-2026-04-02). Release notes show 'improved memory layout' but no config changes to batch limits.
Maya Patel: Looking at pods: several nodes showing high RSS, kernel oom_kill entries on inf-worker-7. Pulling logs now.
Benji Park: I see the anomaly in request latencies aligning with a third-party event that burst traffic ~09:20 (external webhook spike). Could be amplification.
Maya Patel: Logs snippet: ```
[09:20:18] inf-worker-07 ERROR kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 14231 (python) total-vm:2112328kB, anon-rss:1203456kB
[09:20:19] inf-gateway WARN: upstream returned 502 for /v1/generate
[09:20:21] autoscaler INFO: scale_up delayed due to quota check
```
Ava Nguyen: Noted. Mitigation plan?
Maya Patel: Immediate mitigations applied: 1) rolled back model-a-2026-04-02 -> model-a-stable at 09:26, 2) cordoned node inf-worker-07, 3) temporarily throttled external webhook consumer at the edge at 09:28.
DevOps-Bot: Rollback completed: model-a -> model-a-stable (rev f2c3) at 09:26:12 by maya.
Maya Patel: Error rate down to 1.2% at 09:31. Will keep monitoring.
Oscar Ruiz: For handoff: I'll take the RCA lead. Maya please add initial timeline and raw logs to the incident doc.
Maya Patel: Handoff notes: hypothesis = model packaging change changed tensor alignment for odd-length sequences causing higher memory pressure; contributing = sudden external burst + autoscaler quota delay; evidence = OOM messages, mem profile samples (drive link: https://drive.example/INC5238/profiles), webhook spike graph in dboard.
Benji Park: Customer impact summary: ~3,800 requests errored over 9 minutes, ~120 customers contacted support, 8 customers reported production impact (payment flows). Severity might be S2 for those customers; we'll include in RCA.
SRE-Manager: Schedule a postmortem write session. Suggest 2026-04-03 16:00 PT (60 min) to draft timeline and agree owners. Who will own timelines, infra analysis, customer comms, and remediation?
Oscar Ruiz: I'll own infra analysis & reproduce. Benji will do customer impact & comms. Maya will own timeline & logs. Ava will write remediation plan and CI gating.
Maya Patel: Action items logged: 
- AI-5238-1: Populate incident timeline + attach raw logs (Maya) 12026-04-03T00:00:00Z
- AI-5238-2: Bisect packaging changes + reproduce oom locally (Oscar) 12026-04-04T08:00:00Z
- AI-5238-3: Compile affected customer list & comms draft (Benji) 12026-04-03T23:00:00Z
- AI-5238-4: Add model packaging unit test for tensor layout + add pipeline gate (Ava) 12026-04-10T00:00:00Z
- AI-5238-5: Request temporary autoscaler quota bump for prod-east to reduce scale lag (SRE-Manager) 12026-04-05T12:00:00Z
Oscar Ruiz: Repro command I'm running: ```bash
python tests/repro_oom.py --model model-a-2026-04-02 --seq 1537 --batch 6 --mem-debug
```
Ava Nguyen: For remediation plan: recommend 1) packaging tests for layout, 2) add model mem regression alert tied to RSS per-pod, 3) autoscaler pre-warm on known traffic windows, 4) webhook consumer backpressure and graceful degradation. I'll draft details in doc.
Maya Patel: Postmortem doc: https://docs.example/incidents/INC5238-rca-draft (please add comments). Meeting invite: https://meet.example/pm-inc5238 (2026-04-03 16:00 PT).
Benji Park: Customer comms: drafting templated note, will propose top-8 affected receive personal outreach. Filing support tickets now.
SRE-Manager: Peer reviewers requested: @Oscar, @Ava, @Infra-Lead. After peer review, sign-off required from SRE-Manager + Product PM. Target sign-off: 2026-04-09 EOD.
Maya Patel: Quick note: I captured a heap snapshot before rollback, uploading to drive. Also adding a note to include alert rule IDs and incident runbook steps that executed.
Oscar Ruiz: I'll run binary diff on packaging toolchain and include artifact hashes. If repro is deterministic, will propose an immediate unit test.
DevOps-Bot: Incident INC-5238 MITIGATED at 09:31:02 by maya. Ticket INC-5238 created in tracker and linked.
Benji Park: Will coordinate comms with Legal for customers with payment impact.
Maya Patel: Leaving this thread for handoff. Oscar will lead RCA and will ping when draft is ready for review. Thanks all for the quick responses. :pray:
SRE-Manager: Good containment. Make sure to track mitigation cost and any follow-up infra changes. Closing incident channel messages; move final draft to postmortems when ready.
Ava Nguyen: Noted. I'll add remediation milestones to roadmap and link back to the incident doc.
Maya Patel: End of thread.
